library(targets)

params_df <- tar_read(params_df)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(params_df))) {

  child_env <- new.env()
  child_env$params <- list(row_id = i)

  content <- knitr::knit_child(
    "template.qmd",
    envir = child_env,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  cat("{{< pagebreak >}}")
  cat(content)
}
